result.title: Forward-Only Learning for Shared-Kernel Wavelet Neural Networks without Backpropagation
result.summary: Backpropagation remains the dominant training paradigm, using backward gradients and local updates that can suffer from vanishing or exploding gradients in deep networks. Although the Forward-Forward algorithm avoids conventional backpropagation, it remains mainly local or layer-wise, motivating global whole-network learning using forward evaluations only. For shared-kernel wavelet neural networks, we therefore propose a CMA-ES-based global forward-only learning framework. We further introduce structure-aware parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment, factorizing the search into three subspaces. On BSDS500, our method reduces test MSE from 4.1783 to 4.0130 and improves PSNR from 42.621 to 42.787~dB over Adam/BP without backward propagation. Beyond these gains, training requires only 6 training-set coverages, compared with 1500 epochs for BP. Ablations show that structural decomposition and aligned credit assignment are more important than increasing population size, demonstrating the feasibility of whole-network forward-only learning for compact reconstruction networks. These results suggest a potential route toward forward-only optimization of compact reconstruction models for resource-constrained imaging and edge or near-sensor systems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出基于 CMA-ES 的全网络 forward-only 训练框架，用于共享核小波神经网络，并通过结构感知的参数分解与通道级贡献分配把搜索拆成三个子空间，在 BSDS500 图像重建上以极少训练轮数超过 Adam/BP 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只在前向评估下优化、把参数分解为子空间并做通道级 credit assignment」可能为 latent 推理状态的训练监督与贡献分配提供线索，但方法面向小型重建网络、与 VLM 推理规模差距大，迁移可行性需核查。
